Our method, which we call Pseudo-Label Refinement (PLR), involves a two-stage process.  First, we use a pre-trained model to generate pseudo-labels for unlabeled data, which are then used to fine-tune the model.  Next, we use the fine-tuned model to generate new pseudo-labels, which are then used to further refine the model.  Our experiments demonstrate that PLR can significantly improve the performance of object detection models, even when only a small amount of labeled data is available.
